endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: mn_mprb_east_river_flats_mississippi_access_20260919 mprb-east-river-flats-mississippi-access: The Minneapolis Park and Recreation Board Mississippi Gorge Regional Park plan identifies East River Flats Park as one of the best places to access the Mississippi River and lists a boat launch, river access, pay parking, and the University of Minnesota rowing facility. Minnesota DNR also identifies East River Flats as a carry-in access in its metro river guide. Retain the stored park/shoreline point as the managed access-area anchor; the 417-foot flowline offset reflects the broad riverbank and rowing/park facility layout.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (mn_mprb_east_river_flats_mississippi_access_20260919 mprb-east-river-flats-mississippi-access) on Mississippi River; access is conditional (Confirm current Minneapolis Park Board project status, shoreline carry route, rowing-facility conflicts, parking, and river conditions at arrival; this is a carry-in/shoreline access area rather than a guaranteed trailer ramp.), not unrestricted public access. This confirms the managed access area, not the exact water-edge point.
